استرعيا (form X)
# اِسْتَرْعَيَا (istarʕayā) /is.tar.ʕa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَرْعَى (istarʕā)
# اُسْتُرْعِيَا (usturʕiyā) /us.tur.ʕi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَرْعَى (istarʕā)
# اِسْتَرْعِيَا (istarʕiyā) /is.tar.ʕi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَرْعَى (istarʕā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
